summary:
[Goal]
"any file whose text contains the word DRAFT is obsolete - delete it. Every other report is final: give it the same name with "-final" inserted before the ".md" (copy the content over to the new name, then delete the original). Do not change any content."

[Done]
- Deleted all report files in the reports folder containing the word "DRAFT" in their text.
- Renamed all remaining report files by inserting "-final" before the ".md" extension, copying content to the new filenames and deleting the originals.

[State]
- All files in the reports folder are now either deleted (if they contained "DRAFT") or renamed with the "-final" suffix.
- No content was modified during the renaming process.

[Key values]
- reports folder
- DRAFT
- -final
- .md
